altloc_policy.atom_resolution: Use a valid record with the selected label; if none, use a valid shared record. Never borrow an atom from another nonshared altloc label.
altloc_policy.duplicate_same_label_atom_records: Flag for inspection; do not resolve by file row order.
altloc_policy.if_no_valid_nonshared_backbone_records: Choose the first nonshared label in ascending case-sensitive order, if any; otherwise shared atoms only.
altloc_policy.note: Altloc labels are local identifiers. Selecting the same label across residues does not establish correlated states.
altloc_policy.selection_score: Mean occupancy of valid nonshared N, CA, C and O records for each candidate altloc label.

angle_policy.phi: Compute only with valid previous C, current N, CA, C and a valid previous-to-current polymer connection.
angle_policy.psi: Compute only with valid current N, CA, C, next N and a valid current-to-next polymer connection.

compatibility.feature_column_order: retain frozen Step33 feature manifest order
compatibility.sequence_context_and_position_features: Retain historical standard-residue-list conventions for prev/next one-hot, position fraction and chain length; use separate label-sequence keys for geometry and mapping.

coordinate_identity.conflicting_residue_identity: Flag for inspection; do not silently choose one identity.

model_policy.conflict_with_saved_validation_model: Stop that candidate for inspection; do not silently reconcile.

polymer_continuity.threshold_purpose: Angle validity only; not an entry exclusion threshold.

scope: Supplement previously unspecified coordinate-feature implementation details. Do not revise candidate selection or historical release artifacts.

selection_boundary.reconstruction_failures: Record as feature-stage failures pending explicit eligibility review; do not silently change the winner.

structure_features.environment: All standard protein residues in all chains of the selected structural model, using the same atom policy.
structure_features.missing_target_N_or_no_usable_oxygen_env: oxygen-distance/count features are NaN; hbond proxy mask is 0
structure_features.same_chain_local_oxygen_exclusion: Exclude target residue and polymer label_seq_id offsets -1 and +1; do not use filtered residue-list offsets.

requirements: occupancy is finite and greater than zero
